265:         } else if (node.getScope() instanceof ThisExpr) {

267:             // corresponding to 'this'
268:             SymbolReference<ResolvedTypeDeclaration> solve = facade.solve((ThisExpr) node.getScope());
269:             // If found get it's declaration and get the field in there
270:             if (solve.isSolved()) {
271:                 ResolvedTypeDeclaration correspondingDeclaration = solve.getCorrespondingDeclaration();
272:                 if (correspondingDeclaration instanceof ResolvedReferenceTypeDeclaration) {
273:                     return solveDotExpressionType(correspondingDeclaration.asReferenceType(), node);
274:                 }
275:             }

277:         } else if (node.getScope().toString().indexOf('.') > 0) {
278:             // try to find fully qualified name
279:             SymbolReference<ResolvedReferenceTypeDeclaration> sr =
280:                     typeSolver.tryToSolveType(node.getScope().toString());
281:             if (sr.isSolved()) {
282:                 return solveDotExpressionType(sr.getCorrespondingDeclaration(), node);
283:             }
284:         }

286:         try {

288:         } catch (UnsolvedSymbolException use) {
289:             // This node may have a package name as part of its fully qualified name.
290:             // We should solve for the type declaration inside this package.
291:             SymbolReference<ResolvedReferenceTypeDeclaration> sref = typeSolver.tryToSolveType(node.toString());
292:             if (sref.isSolved()) {
293:                 return new ReferenceTypeImpl(sref.getCorrespondingDeclaration());
294:             }
295:         }
296:         if (value.isPresent()) {
297:             return value.get().getType();
298:         }
299:         throw new UnsolvedSymbolException(node.getName().getId());
300:     }
